name: Lead By Example
overview: Scripture calls leaders to shepherd the church with vigilance and holiness, as seen in Acts 20:28 and Titus 1:7, emphasizing the responsibility to care for God's people with integrity and self-control. Believers are encouraged to imitate godly examples, following the faith and conduct of those who lead well, as highlighted in Philippians 3:17 and Hebrews 13:7. Moreover, submission to spiritual leaders is urged, recognizing their accountability before God and the importance of their joyful stewardship, as taught in Hebrews 13:17 and Philippians 4:9.
